text:
deploybot: auto-publish failed for myorg/myservice:staging-2026-03-21-001 -> blocking promote due to manifest/tag conflict.

maria: seeing the same failure in CI, build job 4582. Which digest did it try to push?

deploybot: attempted digest sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6... existing tag points to sha256:deadbeefcafebabe... Tag immutability policy prevented overwrite.
Error snippet:
```
PUT /v2/myorg/myservice/manifests/staging-2026-03-21-001 -> 409 Conflict: tag already exists with different manifest
```

jamie: is this from a near-simultaneous build? could be a parallel CI run or a flaky build-id mapping. We need quick decision: manual retag, pin to existing digest, or rollback.

alex: change window starts in ~30m. If we can't get a deterministic digest we should rollback to the last stable digest (staging@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe) and re-run the hotfix outside window. Less risk.

maria: I can try a manual put-image by digest to rebind the tag to the expected manifest, but provenance/cosign metadata might not match and could be rejected by publish guard. Command I plan to try:
```
# fetch manifest by digest
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name myservice --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f6... --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text > manifest.json
# push with tag
aws ecr put-image --repository-name myservice --image-tag staging-2026-03-21-001 --image-manifest file://manifest.json
```
If the registry rejects it due to provenance mismatch we'll fall back to pin.

ryan: note for release notes — if we rollback we must mark the hotfix as deferred and add a short blurb explaining the tag conflict and next steps.

jamie: decision proposal: pin to existing digest (safer) and roll back this rollout. File follow-up to root cause (parallel builds / build-id collision). @maria, can you try pin and confirm?

maria: running the pin now, trying to promote the existing digest as the stable reference. If manual put-image fails due to immutability, I'll mark the release to use the existing digest explicitly.

deploybot: deploybot: auto-promote paused and ticket INF-4821 created with logs attached. Notifying on-call.

maria: pinned release to staging@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe and verified pulls: docker pull myorg/myservice@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe -> succeeded locally. :white_check_mark: Updated changelog PR with "hotfix deferred, will re-run build outside change window" and added label `deferred-hotfix`.

alex: thanks. I'll open an infra ticket to add a guard against concurrent pushes to the same tag (suggestion: optimistic-locking via ephemeral build tags + canonicalize by digest before promote).

jamie: I marked the rollout as rolled back in the release tracker and notified Product. Closing this thread for the immediate window, leaving INF-4821 open for root-cause and remediation. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
